grok.rationale: The slice states that the Company's execution/liquidity/analytics/workflow business and client relationships passed to Virtu as the acquired operating business of the Surviving Corporation, so T4 and T5 crossed together with no product-vs-process structural mismatch at closing (gap_45=0).
